[[Attuma Duum]]'s '''headquarters''' was placed in a hollowed-out [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] near [[Cavamina Minor]]. The base consisted of five domed structures and a larger facility along the wall of the asteroid, which included numerous amenities. A [[Battle of Cavamina Minor|battle]] took place near the base. Attuma Duum was defeated by two [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals, and the base was destroyed during their fight.

==Description==
{{Expandsect}}
The base used by [[Attuma Duum]] was in a hollowed-out [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] near the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Cavamina Minor]]. A large 30-story structure was attached to the wall, and pipes connected to the structure ran to five other facilities under domes. Attuma Duum had a domed control center under the [[Star/Legends|stars]] with a throne-like chair. An escape hatch led to [[Class-6 escape pod/Legends|Class-6 escape pods]]. That dome had a room with turbines it it. Prisoners were held with their hands in [[Force field/Legends|force fields]].

The whole site was protected from the other asteroids by [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], but safety protocols provided back-up power. The base also had [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] and [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]].

==History==
Attuma Duum was using this facility to run his [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] empire around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] and to profit from the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Duum was passing information to both sides. One set of communications resulted in a [[Battle of Cavamina Minor|battle near the asteroid field]]. Duum had used his [[Unidentified bomber|bombers]] to place 600000 [[Space mine/Legends|space mines]]. Duum passed on falsified information regarding a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] convoy to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]], and passed on information to the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] about a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] which would be in the system. Both fleets reverted from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in the middle of the mine fields, and proceeded to fire on each other in the confusing circumstances before fleeing the system.

During the battle, Duum's two [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] captives, [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and [[Shon-Ju]] escaped from their holding area and confronted the mercenary in his command center. His chief of security, [[Sabat (mercenary)|Sabat]] was [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-tossed]] into a turbine, causing an explosion and killing the [[Human/Legends|man]]. Duum dismissed his crew, sending them to the casinos. Duum revealed his [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] body and directly fought Shon-Ju but was bested. Secura intervened to keep Shon-Ju from killing Duum, allowing the cyborg to escape. Shon-Ju then fought Secura, but she bested him in turn, causing the defeated man to run into the spreading flames. The damage caused eventually led to the destruction of Duum's base, but not before the principal players escaped. Duum's empire was then considered crippled.

==Behind the scenes==
This headquarters was introduced and then destroyed in [[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju|''Volume 5'']] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (graphic novellas)|''The Clone Wars'' graphic novellas]].
